description: Manual observations on source-000223.png, source-001117.png and source-002011.png extracted by encoded video-frame index. All three were visually inspected: stationary front-interior windshield view. Coordinates are unscaled 1920x1080 pixels, approximately +/-1.5 px. Front canopy post and left post are fitting observations; the second right post and rear post are held-out direction checks. These are world-up direction constraints, not invented 3D point correspondences. The three frames repeat one pose and do not validate exterior camera views.
